title: Casa La Torre
subtitle: Exclusivity - Exceptional Waterfront Villa
description:
The Location: A Unique Opportunity
Situated at the most strategic point of the Puerto Aventuras marina, where the Caribbean extends into the serenity of the canals, Casa La Torre redefines exclusivity. Facing a shore of preserved tropical vegetation, it offers a panoramic view that no other property can match.

Casa La Torre: Between Heritage and Modernity
Built in 2003 and featuring a masterful renovation in 2022, this 7,535 sq.ft. Villa on an 8,944 sq.ft. lot combines coastal charm with contemporary luxury.
• Master Suites: 2 exceptional suites on the main floor with deep canal views and access to a wide balcony.
• Themed Bedrooms: 4 additional bedrooms, each with a unique identity.
• Bath Spaces: 4 bathrooms with walk-in showers, whirlpool tubs, natural materials, and fine cabinetry.
• Living and Dining Room: An open concept of 1,250 sq.ft. with contemporary furniture and solid wood. The large windows slide away to merge the interior with the covered terrace.
• Chef’s Kitchen: An elegant space with solid granite countertops and a central island, ideal for entertaining in an authentic atmosphere.

The Exterior: An Art of Living
What makes this property unique is not just its size, but its details designed for water enthusiasts.
• Private Waterfront: 150 ft. of canal frontage with a private dock.
• Outdoor Oasis: A 381 sq.ft. pool with a water fountain feature and a sun-terrace with spectacular views.
• High-End Palapa: A 452 sq.ft. area featuring a summer kitchen and lounge.
• Rooftop: A 3,035 sq.ft. space with a partial ocean view and 36 solar panels.
• Collector’s Garage: A 1,345 sq.ft. garage
• Nautical Garage: For 2 jet skis, paddleboards, and equipment.

Lifestyle and Investment
Whether a primary residence or a strategic wealth asset, Casa La Torre embodies the perfect harmony between the pleasure of the sea and the security of a sustainable investment.
